title: Austin's Money Matters: Budget, Taxes, Pay
summary:
*   **Finalizing City Budget:** Approved Austin's budget for the upcoming 1967-1968 fiscal year.
*   **Setting Property Taxes:** Formalized the ad valorem (property) taxes to be levied for 1967.
*   **Adjusting Employee Pay:** Confirmed changes to the wages and salaries for city employees.
*   **Modifying City Fees:** Enacted adjustments to various city service fees and charges.
transcript:
= CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: Notice is hereby given that a
Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Austin will be held on the 26th day of
September, 1967, at the Municipal Building, Eighth and Colorado, in Austin, Texas, at
10:00 A.M. for the purpose of passing through their second readings the ordinances
presented on September 25, 1967. (The ordinance adopting the Budget for the Fiscal Year
1967-1968, Ordinance No. 670925-A; the ordinance levying ad valorem taxes for 1967,
Ordinance No. 670925-B; also ordinances concerning wage and salary adjustments; and
ordinances making adjustments in fees and charges.) S/ Elsie Woosley
City Clerk
